Multiple Indian Education Boards Announce Exam Dates and Admit Cards

Several Indian education boards and recruitment agencies have released notifications, admit cards, and exam schedules for various examinations. These include recruitment for IBPS PO, MT, and SO, the CDAC C-CAT exam, Haryana HTET, and CBSE supplementary exams for Class 10 and 12. Deadlines and result expectations for other exams like NEET PG and AIBE 21 have also been updated.
